notes.title: Release Date!
notes.notes:
Hey there!

I'm really happy to announce that [b]Black Mountain Kings[/b] will be released on November 14th!

The game currently features:
[list][*]2 major cities
[*]2 party members
[*]7 dungeons + 3 overworld areas
[*]~40 different enemies
[*]7 bosses + some mini bosses
[*]Several side quests
[*]48 achievements
[/list]

notes.title: New version of the demo!
notes.notes:
Hey there!
It's been a while, but the new demo is here!

What is new:
[list]
[*]Overworld map
[*]Attributes (STR, AGI, VIT, DEX, RES, INT) have a maximum value, defined by the starting class
[*]Class descriptions
[*]A lot of bug fixes
[/list]

The game will be released in Early Access soon, so keep an eye on it!

notes.title: New version of the demo!
notes.notes:
Hey there!
Steam Next Fest starts next Monday, so I'm releasing a new version of the demo!

This new version includes:
[list]
[*]A new area to the south of Vila Nova
[*]4 new common enemies
[*]1 new mini-boss
[*]1 new boss
[*]Matilda will craft two new pieces of equipment, as long as you bring her the materials.
[*]Much better performance while navigating the game's menus 
[/list]
